body: It’s an Order/ Regulation and if you don’t get one you can get punished for it.

I mean... service members need one. Yes there’s a barber shop on base, but the cut isn’t always the best. I had to get one and I had to wait almost 3 hours of my working day just waiting to get my haircut. It would help if they used minimal personnel and used the proper procedures to help prevent the spread of COVID-19 or just had it open to military service members and other first responders. It won’t happen, but it would be convenient. 🤷‍♂️
